messages:
nina: QuickFYI 1: I'm refreshing the Hello Quickstart for SDK v9. Need to swap auth examples to token-based and tighten the Docker + Cloud Run deploy steps.

raj: I can handle the Cloud Run doc. Should we standardize on node:20 and python:3.11 snippets?

carmen: Yes, keep both but minimal. Also the env var name changed: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN. We should add a one-line migration callout right under Auth.

nina: Exactly. Also include a local .env example and a curl sanity-check using the new Authorization header.

raj: Minimal node Dockerfile I'll add to the PR:
```
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```

carmen: Add a CLI one-liner to create a token for demos: `redwoodctl tokens create --title quickstart --output json` then export value into REDWOOD_TOKEN. Keep instructions marked demo-only.

preview-bot: Preview site ready: https://deploy-preview-4332--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 15m)

nina: I'll open the PR now and assign @raj and @carmen for review. We should also add a tiny troubleshooting bullet for 401s: check exported REDWOOD_TOKEN and shell scope.

raj: Will verify Cloud Run example tomorrow and confirm masked headers in logs.

carmen: Small copy nit: change "rotate keys" to "migrate keys to tokens" in the migration blurb.

nina: Noted. PR link in thread after I push.
